about_the_game:
ONE MATCH. EVERY WAY TO LIVE IT.

Motion Soccer is a football simulator designed for VR, but also fully playable without VR on a monitor, where you do much more than simply play.

Step onto the pitch in first person, coach from the sideline or grab the whistle and referee the match yourself. Play full 11v11 matches with clubs and national teams inspired by real football and experience the same game from completely different roles.

🟨 BE THE REFEREE

Call fouls, show cards and control the flow of the match directly from the pitch.

⚽ PLAY IN FIRST PERSON

Feel every pass, dribble and shot from inside the action. Use Standard Control with sticks or go deeper with Expert Control, moving your hands like your feet to strike the ball with greater immersion.

🎯 COACH FROM THE SIDELINE

Experience the match in first person from the bench or control the strategy using the tactical view. Adjust formations and make real-time decisions to change the course of the match.

🏆 PLAY A FULL SEASON

Choose your club or national team and compete in league and cup, managing team morale and facing press conferences throughout the season.

🌍 MULTIPLAYER UP TO 11v11

Play online from 1v1 up to full 11v11 matches, combining human players and AI. Each participant can join the same match from a different perspective.

One match. Every way to live it.
requirements_minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 4590 or AMD FX 8350 or greater
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 970/AMD Radeon R9 290 equivalent or greater
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Sound Card
  • VR Support: Oculus headsets (meta quest and rift) and valve index.

  • Processor: Intel Core i5 4590 or AMD FX 8350 or greater
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 970/AMD Radeon R9 290 equivalent or greater
